review_evidence: README explicitly describes the project as unfinished OpenSSL bindings for Lean.
A complete scan of its two Lean files found eight declaration-style lines and no theorem, lemma, axiom, or proposition-example declarations.

OpenSSL.lean consists of an opaque SSL client handle and external ssl_init/ssl_client_init bindings; it does not formalize TLS/OpenSSL semantics, conformance, security properties, or correctness of the foreign implementation.

source_action.content_invariant: The source only exposes opaque/extern OpenSSL handles and calls plus build configuration, with no propositions or independent protocol/security semantics. Retirement therefore removes no mathematical theorem/proof, formal specification, or formal-semantics prior art.
